original: ルーティの夢って\n孤児院建てる事なんでしょ？
traducao: Your dream is to build\nan orphanage, right, Rutee?

original: ど〜お？　\n調子の方は
traducao: So, how's it going?\nMaking good progress?

original: ま、ぼちぼち……ってとこかしら？
traducao: Well, slowly but surely, I suppose?

original: 当然、資金面ではまだまだだけど\nここでいくらか稼がせてもらってるしね
traducao: Financially, I still have a way to go,\nbut I make decent money here, at least.

original: 幸い、スタンの奴も\n色々協力してくれてるし
traducao: Luckily, that guy Stahn has been\nhelping out in all sorts of ways, too.

original: スタンとルーティってさ〜、\nぶっちゃけデキてんの？
traducao: So between you and Stahn...\nHonestly, are you two an item?

original: はぁ！？
traducao: What!?

original: ちょっと、やめてよ！
traducao: Hey, cut it out!

original: あいつはそんなんじゃないってば。\n放っておけば、丸一日だって\n昏々と眠り続ける様なスカタンよ？
traducao: He is totally not like that!\nLeave him alone, and that dummy would\nsleep like a log for an entire day!

original: ないない。\nありえないわ。\nほんっとに
traducao: No way, no way.\nNot a chance in hell.\nSeriously!

original: ふーん、そうなの？\n結構お似合いの二人に見えたけど
traducao: Hmm, really?\nYou two seemed like quite a good match.

original: ま、やっぱ将来の事考えると\nどうしたって慎重になるしねぇ
traducao: Well, when thinking about the future,\nyou can't help being cautious, huh?

original: ソレとコレとは別問題ってヤツ？
traducao: Like that's one thing, this is another?

original: 当然よ。\n大体、あいつにそんな甲斐性ないもの
traducao: Naturally.\nBesides, that guy has zero dependability.

original: もし将来、あいつが結婚する事があるなら\nぜひともそのお相手の顔を見てみたいわね
traducao: If he ever gets married in the future,\nI'd love to see who'd actually take him!

original: ルーティは、お宝だったら\n何でも持って行っちゃうの？
traducao: Rutee, if it's treasure,\ndo you take anything and everything?

original: まぁ、基本的にはそうね。\n何たって、お宝なんだし♪
traducao: Well, pretty much, yeah.\nAfter all, it's treasure!

original: そっか……
traducao: I see...

original: 何よ？
traducao: What is it?

original: あ、えっと……\nちょっともったいない気も\nするなぁと思って……
traducao: Ah, well...\nI was just thinking\nit feels kind of like a shame...

original: 昔、習った事があるんだ。\n遺跡から、歴史の解明の手がかりになる\n宝物がどんどん持ち出されて……
traducao: I learned about this once.\nWhen relics that hold clues to history\nare carried away from ruins...

original: 結果的に何百年も、重要な歴史的研究が\n遅れてしまう事例があるんだって
traducao: It can end up setting important\nhistorical research back by centuries.

original: ちょっと、あたしをそこらの盗掘家と\n一緒にしないでよね
traducao: Hey, don't lump me in with some\nrun-of-the-mill tomb raider!

original: ご、ごめん。\nそういうわけじゃ……
traducao: S-Sorry!\nThat's not what I meant...

original: でもまぁ、ルカの言う事も一理あるわ。\nだからって、あたしの生き方が\nどう変わるってわけでもないけどね
traducao: Still, you do make a fair point, Ruca.\nNot that it's going to change how I live\nmy life, though.

original: どんな高尚な理屈をこねたって\n結局、世界は「今」を生きる者の為に\nあるってあたしは考えてる
traducao: No matter how lofty the argument,\nI believe the world exists for those\nliving in the "now."

original: もちろん、過去をないがしろにする\nつもりはないわ。\nだけど
traducao: Of course, I don't mean to\nignore the past entirely.\nEven so...

original: 過去の為に、ただ\n「今」を犠牲にするのは\n間違ってるんじゃないかしらね
traducao: Sacrificing the "now"\npurely for the sake of the past\njust feels wrong to me.

original: そっか。\nルーティがお金を稼いでいる理由って……
traducao: I see.\nThe reason you're earning money is...

original: あたしには、あたしの帰りを待ってて\n帰る家を必要としてる子ども達がいるの
traducao: I have kids who are waiting for me,\nkids who need a place to call home.

original: みんな、今を……\n今日を生き延びる為に必死なのよ
traducao: They're all doing everything they can\nto survive right now... to survive today.

original: だからあたしは、あの子達の為にも\nあたしに出来る事をする。\nこれから先も、ずっとね
traducao: So for those children's sake,\nI'll do everything that I can.\nFrom now on, and always.

original: うん……わかったよ
traducao: Yeah... I understand.

original: 色んな立場の人が\nいるって事なんだよね
traducao: Everyone has their own circumstances\nthey're dealing with, huh?

original: 世の中って、難しいや……
traducao: The world really is complicated...

original: で？　\n結局イリアとの仲はどうなのよ
traducao: So? How are things going\nbetween you and Iria, anyway?

original: い、いきなり何でその話になるの
traducao: W-Why bring that up all of a sudden!?

original: あれだけ毎日一緒にいるんだもの
traducao: You two are together every single day.

original: お互いどうも思ってないって\n事はないでしょ
traducao: Don't tell me neither of you\nfeels anything for the other.

original: そう、なのかな……
traducao: Is... is that really true...?

original: よく、わからないよ……
traducao: I really don't know...

original: イリアはすごく可愛いし……\nスタイルもいいし、明るいし……
traducao: Iria is really cute...\nShe's got a great figure, so cheerful...

original: だけど、僕は男らしくもないし\n特にこれっていう魅力も……
traducao: But I'm not manly at all,\nand I don't really have any charm...

original: 〜〜〜っ、ああもう！\n煮え切らないわね！！
traducao: Aaargh, geez!\nQuit being so wishy-washy!!

original: ひっ
traducao: Eep!

original: で？　\nあんたは結局どうしたいの
traducao: So? What do you actually\nwant in the end?

original: イリアと上手くいきたいの？\nいきたくないの？
traducao: Do you want things to work out\nwith Iria or not?

original: そ、そりゃ……。\n上手くいきたいに決まってるよ……
traducao: W-Well... Of course I want things\nto work out...

original: そうでしょ？
traducao: Thought so!

original: だったら、自信持ちなさい。\nあと、自分で自分を卑下するのは\nやめること
traducao: Then have some confidence!\nAnd stop putting yourself down\nlike that!

original: 自分で自分を好きじゃないのに\nどうして他人が、そんな自分を\n好きになってくれるの？
traducao: If you don't even like yourself,\nhow do you expect anyone else\nto like you?

original: そんなの、それこそ\n見込みがないと思うわよ
traducao: Acting like that really is\na lost cause, you know.

original: な、なるほど……
traducao: I-I see...

original: 大丈夫
traducao: Don't worry.

original: あんたが思う程、あんたの事\n嫌ってなんかないわよ、イリアは
traducao: Iria doesn't dislike you\nnearly as much as you think she does.

original: 多分ね
traducao: Probably, anyway.

original: ついにやったわね！\n所持金、１００万ガルド達成！！
traducao: We finally did it!\nFunds have hit 1,000,000 Gald!!

original: 千里の道も一歩から……と言うけど\n地道な努力の積み重ねが\nここまでのガルドになったのね
traducao: They say a journey of a thousand miles\nbegins with one step... Steady effort\nreally did add up to all this Gald.

original: これだけあれば、\nしばらく生活には困らないね！
traducao: With this much, we won't have\nto worry about getting by for a while!

original: でも！　\n油断は禁物よ？
traducao: Hold on, though!\nNo letting your guard down!

original: １００万ガルドは到達点に過ぎないの。\n問題はこれをどう資産運用して\n額を増やしていくか……
traducao: 1,000,000 Gald is merely a milestone.\nThe question is how to invest it\nto make our funds grow even more...

original: そうね
traducao: Indeed.

original: １００万ガルドあるって思ってても\n使ってみたら、案外あっさり\nなくなっちゃったりするし
traducao: Even with 1,000,000 Gald,\nonce you spend it, it can vanish\nsurprisingly fast.

original: そうそう。\nここからが大事なのよ、ここからが♪
traducao: Exactly!\nFrom here on is what counts, right here!

original: ふうん……そうなんだ
traducao: Hmm... I see.

original: １００万ガルドを使い切っちゃうなんて\nわたしには想像もつかないけどなぁ
traducao: Blowing through 1,000,000 Gald is\nsomething I can't even imagine, though.

original: よ〜っし、所持金５０万ガルド達成！\n夢の１００万ガルドまで、あと少しね
traducao: All riiiight, we've hit 500,000 Gald!\nJust a bit more to the dream 1,000,000!

original: すごい、まさかこんな大金を\n直に見られる日が来るなんて……！
traducao: Incredible! To think I'd see\nso much money with my own eyes...!

original: なぁ、○○。\nちょっとそこでジャンプするよ！
traducao: Hey, ○○!\nJump up and down right there!

original: ガルドがじゃらじゃら、\nきっと音キレイな！
traducao: All the Gald will jingle-jangle,\nsure sound pretty!

original: ちょ、ちょっと待った！
traducao: H-Hold on just a minute!

original: そんな事して\n１ガルドでも落としたらどうするのよ。\nガルドは楽器じゃないのよ？
traducao: What if you do that\nand drop even a single Gald!?\nGald isn't a musical instrument!

original: む〜……どしてもダメか？
traducao: Mmmh... Really no good?

original: もちろん、ダメよ。\n絶対ダメ
traducao: Of course it's no good.\nAbsolutely not!

original: ガルドを入れてる袋の口を\nキッチリ！　締めてからじゃなきゃ、ね
traducao: Not until you've tied up\nthe Gald sack nice and tight!

original: 音を確かめるのは、それからよ。\nね？　\nそれなら、安心出来るでしょ？
traducao: Listening to the sound comes after that.\nRight?\nThat way, we can both rest easy!

original: ワイール！　\nそだな！\n５０万ガルドが音、楽しみだよぅ
traducao: Wa-eel!\nYou right!\nCan't wait to hear 500,000 Gald sound!

original: さすがルーティ。\nお金の扱いから子どもの扱いまで\nぬかりがないわ……
traducao: Leave it to Rutee.\nFrom handling money to handling kids,\nshe doesn't miss a beat...

original: ロニってホント\n美人に目がないのねえ
traducao: Loni, you really have\na massive weakness for beauties, huh?

original: そりゃあもう！\n美女は目の保養ですから！
traducao: Hell yeah, I do!\nBeautiful women are a feast for the eyes!

original: もちろん、ルーティさんにも\nいつも心を潤わせてもらってますよ∀
traducao: Of course, you always soothe my heart\nas well, Miss Rutee :)

original: はいはい。\nま、男って得てしてそういうものよね
traducao: Yeah, yeah.\nMen tend to be that way, I guess.

original: 中身よりも見た目重視！\n全く、わかりやすいわよねえ
traducao: Looks over substance!\nHonestly, you're so predictable.

original: 待ってくれよ。\nそういうくくられ方はちょっと心外だぜ
traducao: Hold on a second!\nLumping me in like that is uncalled for!

original: 何よ。\nあんたは違うっていうの？
traducao: What?\nYou saying you're any different?

original: もちろんだ。\n見た目よりも、大切なのは心！
traducao: Of course I am!\nWhat matters isn't looks, but heart!

original: どんなヒトであれ、\nそれだけは絶対に言えるって\nおれは思ってるぜ！！
traducao: No matter who the person is,\nthat's one thing I can say for sure!\nI believe that with all my heart!!

original: ほう？\nんじゃ、美女と名高いお前の姉貴さんは\n「性格美人」って事なのか？
traducao: Oh? Then your sister,\nrenowned for her beauty,\nis "beautiful on the inside"?

original: チッチッチ……姉貴はな、\n心だけじゃない、見た目も美人なんだよ
traducao: Tsk-tsk-tsk... My big sis isn't just\nkind at heart, she looks gorgeous too!

original: ああそう……
traducao: Right...

original: 結局美女好きなんじゃねえか……
traducao: So you just like babes after all...

original: そんな事ないって。\n姉貴だけは特別なんだよ！
traducao: That's not true!\nMy big sis is just special!

original: 信じてくれよ〜
traducao: Come on, you gotta believe me~!

original: くっ……どうしてわからないんだ
traducao: Damn it... Why can't they understand!?

original: 現状維持ばかりでは何も変わらない！\nそれに気付いていながら、どうして……！
traducao: Just maintaining the status quo changes\nnothing! They know that, so why...!?

original: 随分熱くなってるわね〜。\n……何かあったの？
traducao: You're pretty fired up over there~.\n...Did something happen?

original: ……ああ、ルーティ！　\n聞いてくれ
traducao: ...Ah, Rutee!\nListen to this.

original: 実は、オルタ・ビレッジの有用性について\nぼくがまとめたレポートに\n学会から正式な回答が来たんだ
traducao: Actually, an official response arrived\nfrom the academy regarding my report\non the viability of Olta Village.

original: なるほどね。\n……それで自分の主張が認められなくて、\nつい熱くなってたってわけ？
traducao: I see.\nAnd because your report wasn't accepted,\nyou ended up getting all heated?

original: 彼らはどうかしている！\nこのまま世界がただれていくのを\n手をこまねいて見ていろというのか！！
traducao: They've lost their minds!\nAre they saying we should just sit by\nand watch the world rot away like this!?

original: 落ち着きなさいよ。\n今のあんたにとって大事なのは\n学会から評価される事じゃないでしょ？
traducao: Calm down.\nWhat matters to you right now isn't\ngetting praised by the academy, is it?

original: そ、それは……確かにそうだが
traducao: T-That... That is true, but...

original: だったらいいじゃない。\n言いたい奴には言わせとけばいいのよ
traducao: Then don't sweat it!\nJust let critics say whatever they want.

original: しかし……
traducao: Still...

original: あんたも煮え切らないわねえ。\n自分のしてる事が正しいと思うなら\nとにかくやってみればいいじゃない
traducao: You're pretty wishy-washy too.\nIf you think what you're doing is right,\nthen just go out and do it!

original: 本当にそれが間違った事じゃないなら\n結果は勝手についてくるわ。\nそうでしょ？
traducao: If you're really not mistaken,\nthe results will speak for themselves.\nRight?

original: そうかもしれない……。\nだけど……ぼくは……
traducao: That might be true...\nStill... I...

original: おっかしいわねー……
traducao: That's so weird...

original: 結構食事制限してるのに\nあんまり体重が落ちないわ
traducao: Even though I've been watching my diet,\nmy weight barely drops at all.

original: ルーティ様、\nダイエットをされてたんですか？
traducao: Miss Rutee,\nhave you been on a diet?

original: ダイエットっていう程\n大げさなものじゃないけど、\n体を引き締める為に、ちょっとね
traducao: It's nothing so grand as a "diet,"\njust a little something\nto tone up my body.

original: 体が重いと、その分動きが遅くなるでしょ。\nトレジャーハンターたる者、\n身軽に動けなくちゃ、仕事になんないわ
traducao: If you're heavy, you move slower, right?\nAs a treasure hunter, if I can't stay\nnimble, I can't do my job.

original: なるほど……さすがはプロです。\nしっかり自己管理をされてるんですね
traducao: I see... Truly a professional.\nYou take such good care of yourself.

original: まぁ、それ程でもないけどね〜
traducao: Well, it's not that big a deal~

original: （なるほど……早速、ルーティ様が\n　元気になる特別メニューを\n　考えなくては……。フフフ……）
traducao: (I see... I must concoct a special menu\nto energize Miss Rutee at once...\nHehehe...)

original: ロックス？　\n……今、何か笑った？
traducao: Rocks?\n...Did you just chuckle?

original: はい？　\n何の事でしょうか？
traducao: Pardon?\nWhatever could you mean?

original: ……そうよね。\nあたしの気のせいね
traducao: ...Right.\nJust my imagination.

original: おかしなルーティ様ですね。\nフフフ……
traducao: How curious of you, Miss Rutee.\nHehehe...

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

original: 笑い。\n
traducao: Laughter.\n

traducao: Anger.\n
